source: verified, priced hardware for a small GRBL 2-axis machine (pen plotter / drag-knife / light laser). 2026 ballpark prices; confirm at the link.

components.name: Arduino Uno R3 (ATmega328P)
components.what: Option A brain: the 8-bit MCU board that runs GRBL and generates the step/direction pulses the CNC shield feeds to the drivers.
components.capability: electronics (controller board, stepper drivers, power)
components.license: Open-source hardware (CC-BY-SA); official Arduino reference design

components.name: Protoneer Arduino CNC Shield V3.51
components.what: Option A driver carrier that plugs onto the Uno, breaking out sockets for up to 4 stepper drivers plus endstop, spindle-enable and probe pins.
components.capability: electronics (controller board, stepper drivers, power)

components.name: A4988 stepper driver module (StepStick)
components.what: Option A microstepping drivers, one plugged into the shield per axis, turning step/dir logic into regulated motor coil current. Sold in multipacks (~$11 for 3-5); need 3.
components.capability: electronics (controller board, stepper drivers, power)

components.name: Mean Well LRS-350-24 power supply (24V, 14.6A)
components.what: Both options: enclosed 24V switching supply that powers the stepper motors while the board's logic is fed over USB.
components.capability: electronics (controller board, stepper drivers, power)

components.name: USB cable (PC to controller)
components.what: Both options: the data and G-code-streaming link between the host PC and the controller board.
components.capability: electronics (controller board, stepper drivers, power)

components.name: FluidNC controller board (ESP32 + onboard TMC2209)
components.what: Option B all-in-one brain: an ESP32 board with soldered TMC2209 drivers for 2 axes plus WiFi/Bluetooth and USB, replacing the entire Uno + shield + driver stack. Alternative to the Uno+CNC-Shield path (wireless, onboard drivers); pick one controller.
components.capability: electronics (controller board, stepper drivers, power)

components.name: NEMA 17 bipolar stepper motor (42x42mm, ~1.5A, ~42Ncm)
components.what: One motor per axis drives the X and Y belts; a 42Ncm/1.5A 4-wire NEMA17 is the standard, well-supported size every beginner CNC/plotter build uses.
components.capability: motion + frame (steppers, belts, linear motion, structure)

components.name: GT2 timing belt, 6mm wide, 2mm pitch (5m roll)
components.what: Open-loop belt cut to length transmits motor rotation to linear axis motion; one 5m roll covers both axes of an A3 machine with margin.
components.capability: motion + frame (steppers, belts, linear motion, structure)

components.name: GT2 20T aluminum drive pulley, 5mm bore, 6mm belt
components.what: Bolts onto each stepper's 5mm shaft to pull the belt; 20-tooth gives a clean ~40mm/rev and is the default plotter/3D-printer pulley.
components.capability: motion + frame (steppers, belts, linear motion, structure)

components.name: GT2 20T smooth idler pulley with ball bearing, 3mm bore
components.what: Redirects and tensions the belt at the far end of each axis and at gantry corners so the belt runs parallel; bearing-backed idlers keep it low-friction.
components.capability: motion + frame (steppers, belts, linear motion, structure)

components.name: 8mm hardened chrome-plated smooth rod (~400mm)
components.what: Ground steel shafts are the linear guideways; two per axis (X gantry + Y sides) carry the LM8UU bearings that let the pen carriage slide.
components.capability: motion + frame (steppers, belts, linear motion, structure)

components.name: LM8UU linear ball bearing (8mm bore, 15mm OD, 24mm)
components.what: Rides on the 8mm rods and is what actually carries the moving carriage; two bearings per rod keep each axis from cocking.
components.capability: motion + frame (steppers, belts, linear motion, structure)

components.name: 2020 T-slot aluminum extrusion, 500mm length
components.what: The structural frame: four to six 500mm bars form the base rectangle and gantry uprights that everything else bolts to.
components.capability: motion + frame (steppers, belts, linear motion, structure)

components.name: 2020 corner bracket (L, 3-hole, with slot nuts)
components.what: Right-angle gussets that square and stiffen the extrusion joints so the frame stays orthogonal under belt tension.
components.capability: motion + frame (steppers, belts, linear motion, structure)

components.name: M3/M4/M5 socket-cap screw + T-nut assortment kit
components.what: The fastener bag that mounts motors, brackets, idlers and carriages into the extrusion T-slots and tapped ends; one kit covers a whole small build.
components.capability: motion + frame (steppers, belts, linear motion, structure)

components.name: Flexible shaft coupling, 5mm to 5mm (aluminum spiral/jaw)
components.what: Couples a motor shaft to a lead-screw or shaft extension (e.g. a pen-lift Z or a direct-drive axis) while absorbing minor misalignment.
components.capability: motion + frame (steppers, belts, linear motion, structure)

components.name: MGN12H linear rail + carriage block (~300-400mm) [ALTERNATIVE]
components.what: Preloaded miniature profile rail that replaces the rod+LM8UU pair on an axis for markedly less play and friction, at higher cost.
components.capability: motion + frame (steppers, belts, linear motion, structure)

components.name: SG90 9g micro servo (pen-lift actuator)
components.what: A single hobby micro servo that swings the pen up off the paper and back down on a PWM signal from the controller, giving the machine its Z-lift without a full Z axis.
components.capability: tool head + sensors (pen lift or laser, endstops)

components.name: 3D-printed pen holder / pen-lift bracket
components.what: A printed bracket that mounts the servo to the gantry and clamps the pen, so the servo arm raises and lowers the pen tip a few millimeters.
components.capability: tool head + sensors (pen lift or laser, endstops)
components.license: Free STL; most Printables/Thingiverse pen-lift designs are Creative Commons (CC-BY or CC-BY-NC) — check the specific model's license before any commercial use.

components.name: 5W 450nm diode laser module, 12V PWM/TTL (optional laser tool head)
components.what: A swappable blue-diode laser head with built-in driver and fan that replaces the pen for engraving/light cutting, its power set by the same PWM/TTL pin that would drive a spindle.
components.capability: tool head + sensors (pen lift or laser, endstops)

components.name: Mechanical endstop limit switches, lever microswitch with cable
components.what: Lever-arm microswitches mounted at the axis travel limits so the machine can home to a repeatable origin and avoid crashing the gantry into the frame.
components.capability: tool head + sensors (pen lift or laser, endstops)
